cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I drew the handrail while you called it nonsense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Loud enough for the people using my prediction to get upstairs.
